scientific_question: Can the full-rank attention c_proj Muon request be represented directly by a full-support low-bit code at useful direction fidelity and materially lower persistent storage?

theory.causal_parent: Equal-budget Givens reached recovery 0.236724/cosine 0.493535, while unconstrained directed sparse transport was worse. Both act through the current weight and fail to encode the spectrally flat full-rank polar request.
theory.binary_prediction: For isotropic Gaussian-like entries, the least-squares sign projection has expected cosine sqrt(2/pi)=0.797885. Normalized to the target radius its expected recovery is 2*sqrt(2/pi)-1=0.595769.
theory.scope: This is a memory-compression relaxation with one discrete code per ambient element, not evidence for a low-dimensional parameter manifold. A pass authorizes only a trajectory accumulation and compact-weight-state oracle.

decision_rule.selection: Among passing candidates choose minimum theoretical packed storage ratio, then maximum aggregate recovery, then smaller block size.
decision_rule.pass: Authorize only a separately preregistered multi-step compact residual/weight reconstruction oracle with exact resume and storage accounting. No implementation, MFU preflight, LM training, or larger rung is authorized.
decision_rule.fail: Reject low-bit full-support polar coding at up to four bits and return to a dense c_proj exception or a changed optimizer objective; do not sweep BlockFHT geometry.

execution.monitoring: direct foreground polling; no watchdog or callback
